zh.title: 中華航空訂定第4季目標 貨運單月營收維持80億元
zh.summary: 中華航空公布第4季貨運目標，期許單月業績維持新台幣80億元。
body: 中華航空總經理陳漢銘於9月16日在荷蘭阿姆斯特丹表示，華航今年貨運表現優異，在有限機隊數量的前提下精準投放市場需求。華航針對今年第4季設定營運目標，期望能將單月貨運表現維持在新台幣80億元。當天中華航空也在阿姆斯特丹舉行記者會，慶祝加入天合聯盟15週年。
華航阿姆斯特丹貨運部總經理劉安琪指出，第4季為傳統貨運旺季，台灣身為電子產業重鎮，帶動相關貨物需求。目前自台灣出發的貨量約占三成，另有六成至七成屬於轉機貨運，由亞洲各地匯集至台灣後再轉運至歐洲與北美地區。

en.title: China Airlines Targets NT$80 Billion Monthly Cargo Revenue in Q4
en.summary: China Airlines targets maintaining monthly cargo revenue at NT$80 billion in the fourth quarter.
body: China Airlines President Chen Han-ming stated on September 16 in Amsterdam that the carrier has achieved strong cargo performance this year by effectively matching market demand with its fleet capacity. Speaking at an event marking the airline's 15th anniversary of joining the SkyTeam alliance, Chen outlined operational goals for the fourth quarter, targeting maintaining monthly cargo revenue at NT$80 billion.

Liu An-chi, general manager of China Airlines' cargo department in Amsterdam, noted that the fourth quarter represents the peak season for air freight. Taiwan-originating shipments account for approximately 30 percent of the volume, while 60 to 70 percent consists of transshipment cargo collected across Asia and transferred through Taiwan to European and North American destinations.

zh.title: 華航載客率回升至8成以上 規劃歐洲與大洋洲航線增班
zh.summary: 華航客運載客率提升至82%至85%；轉機客比例上升；規劃增班歐洲與大洋洲航線
body: 中華航空於荷蘭阿姆斯特丹舉行記者會慶祝加入天合聯盟15週年，華航總經理陳漢銘表示，在持續經營團體旅客的策略帶動下，客運載客率已由過往的70%左右提升至82%至85%之間。陳漢銘指出，除了團體旅客提供穩定基本客源外，長程航線的中轉旅客比率亦顯著成長，其中北美航線的轉機客比例高達6成，歐洲航線的轉機客比例也已達到5成。
在個別重點航線表現方面，陳漢銘說明，西雅圖航線有超過6成的旅客是經由台灣中轉前往東北亞及東南亞；鳳凰城航線則吸引不少來自日本、泰國與越南等地的旅客經台灣轉機直飛，目前轉機客占比約為15%且持續增加。此外，受惠於台積電將於歐洲設廠，法蘭克福與布拉格等航線均觀察到旅客人數成長，倫敦經台北前往大洋洲的轉機市場需求亦相當龐大。
針對未來的航網營運規劃，陳漢銘表示，未來2年對華航而言非常關鍵，在陸續引進新機整備完成前，現階段將以既有航線的加嚴加密為主要策略。華航規劃針對歐洲的倫敦與布拉格進行航班增班，並預計於第4季針對大洋洲市場持續增加航班密度，目標是在現有運能基礎上發揮既有競爭優勢，進一步拉開與同業的距離。
在機隊引進與改裝進度方面，陳漢銘透露，華航近年的購機訂單排程已延伸至2030年甚至2032年。除了期待今年年底前交付波音787-9客機之外，未來也將陸續引進空中巴士A350-1000與波音777-9等新世代廣體客機。同時，華航現有的空中巴士A350-900機隊，亦預計於2027年進行客艙改艙工程，以提昇整體服務品質。

en.title: China Airlines Passenger Load Factor Rises to Over 80% Amid Network Expansion Plans
en.summary: China Airlines reports passenger load factor reaching 85 percent and plans frequency increases on long-haul routes.
body: Speaking at a press conference in Amsterdam, Netherlands, celebrating the 15th anniversary of China Airlines joining the SkyTeam alliance, General Manager Chen Han-ming announced that the airline's passenger load factor has risen from around 70 percent in the past to between 82 percent and 85 percent. Chen attributed the performance boost to group travel operations and noted that transit passenger proportions are growing steadily, with North American routes seeing 60 percent transit passengers and European routes reaching 50 percent.

Detailing specific long-haul route performance, Chen noted that more than 60 percent of passengers on the Seattle route connect through Taiwan to Northeast and Southeast Asia. On the Phoenix route, transit passengers from countries such as Japan, Thailand, and Vietnam flying via Taiwan currently account for approximately 15 percent of traffic, with numbers continuing to rise. Furthermore, driven by TSMC's factory setup in Europe, passenger traffic on routes to Frankfurt and Prague has increased, while demand for connections from London via Taipei to Oceania remains strong.

Regarding network plans for the next two years, Chen stated that the focus will be on strengthening and increasing flight frequencies on existing routes before new aircraft are delivered. China Airlines plans to add flight frequencies to London and Prague in Europe, while also planning continued frequency increases for the Oceania market in the fourth quarter to maximize operational advantages under current fleet capacity.

On fleet renewal and cabin upgrades, Chen disclosed that China Airlines' aircraft purchase order delivery timeline extends to 2030 and 2032. In addition to expecting the delivery of a Boeing 787-9 by the end of this year, the carrier plans to introduce Airbus A350-1000 and Boeing 777-9 widebody aircraft in the future. Meanwhile, the airline's current Airbus A350-900 fleet is scheduled to undergo cabin retrofits in 2027 to enhance customer service.

zh.title: 波音與大韓航空敲定103架客貨機大型訂單
zh.summary: 大韓航空完成103架波音客貨機訂單，履行2025年8月採購承諾。
body: 波音與大韓航空於2026年9月16日宣佈，大韓航空已完成103架波音民用飛機的最終訂單。該筆訂單涵蓋雙通道寬體客機與單通道窄體客機，具體包含20架777-9客機、25架787-10客機、50架737-10客機，以及8架777-8貨機。
這項最終確認的訂單履行的正是大韓航空於2025年8月所作出的採購承諾。雙方在韓國首爾舉行活動紀念此里程碑，大韓航空董事長兼執行長趙源泰與波音民用飛機集團總裁兼執行長史蒂芬妮·波普等代表出席儀式。
根據過往公開紀錄，波音737-10機型截至2026年7月已完成認證飛行測試，當時公司預計該機型將於2026年取得認證，並於2027年開始交付。

en.title: Boeing and Korean Air Finalize Order for 103 Widebody and Single-Aisle Jets
en.summary: Korean Air finalized an order for 103 Boeing airplanes, fulfilling a procurement commitment made in August 2025.
body: Boeing and Korean Air announced on September 16, 2026, that the airline has finalized an order for 103 Boeing aircraft across its widebody and single-aisle airplane families. The deal comprises 20 777-9, 25 787-10, 50 737-10, and eight 777-8 Freighter aircraft.

The agreement fulfills Korean Air's procurement commitment originally made in August 2025. The milestone was commemorated at an event in Seoul attended by Korean Air Chairman and CEO Walter Cho and Boeing Commercial Airplanes President and CEO Stephanie Pope.

According to previous company statements, Boeing had completed certification flight testing for the 737-10 variant as of July 2026, with certification anticipated in 2026 and initial delivery expected in 2027.
